verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Activepieces serves a live llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200) with a product summary written for agents, and its docs publish markdown mirrors (.md pages that embed per-operation OpenAPI) that an agent can consume directly. The root /docs.md path returned 404, and nothing shows an agent actually being used against these docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or complete docs bundle, a working root docs.md, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: with per-operation OpenAPI embedded in every endpoint page's markdown mirror
